newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Sweden car registrations up 27 pct July. [CORRECTED 14:15 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Sweden car registrations up 27 pct July. [CORRECTED 14:15 GMT]

text.p: (corrects title and first paragraph from 13 pct to 27 pct, corrects number of vehicles from 13,400 to 15,042).

STOCKHOLM, Aug 1 (Reuter), Registrations of new cars in Sweden rose 27 percent in July compared to July last year to 15,042 vehicles, the Association of Swedish Automobile Manufacturers and Wholesalers said on Friday.
The association said between January and July the number of new cars registered rose 29 percent from a year ago to 129,489.
Sweden's official statistics bureau, Statistics Sweden, released its new car registration figures for July at 0800 GMT Friday, showing a 35.3 percent rise in new registrations of cars to 18,089.

The association said its 1997 figures no longer included private imports which explained why its figures were lower than Statistic Sweden's figures and the difference between the two in the future would be greater.
